description: Verify Wave1 produced topic-scoped skeleton artifacts: wave1 directory exists, per-topic skeleton files exist, each skeleton contains the foundation-placeholder marker, no false completion claims present, trace evidence present, status values point to wave1→wave2.

rules.failure_message: Missing directory: artifacts/wave1/. Create the directory and add per-topic skeleton files.
Missing skeleton file: artifacts/wave1/{topic}/skeleton.md. Write a topic-scoped skeleton for each topic in the topic_registry.

Missing required marker 'capability: foundation-placeholder' in skeleton file. Each skeleton must explicitly declare this marker to indicate it is foundation placeholder content, not full subagent research.
False completion claim detected: 'full subagent coverage completed'. Foundation phase does not do subagent dispatch — remove this claim.
False completion claim detected: 'deepening done'. Foundation phase only produces placeholder skeletons — remove this claim.
False completion claim detected: 'candidate intake completed'. Candidate intake is a future expansion track — remove this claim.
False completion claim detected: 'fan-in review completed'. Fan-in review is a future expansion track — remove this claim.
Missing trace event: wave1_completion. The phase body requires recording this event in rb_trace.jsonl before running the gate.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'wave1_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct gate value.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'wave2_complete'. Status may have drifted — restore the correct value.
